options_evaluated: Single-polymer high-strength ABS with recycled content
Multi-material overmolded plastic with glass-fiber reinforcement
decisions.conflict: In-Service Agent recommends high-durability impact-resistant virgin ABS to prevent premature physical degradation and microplastic release, while Circularity Agent recommends single-polymer unpainted polypropylene to maximize recyclability.
espr_constraint: ESPR 2024/1781 Annex I (a), page 79: durability and reliability of the product or its components
ESPR 2024/1781 Annex I (d), page 80: ease and quality of recycling
ESPR 2024/1781 Annex I (p), page 80: microplastic and nanoplastic release
decisions.chief_resolution: Single-polymer high-strength ABS with recycled content. This option balances engineering feasibility (providing the necessary impact resistance and structural integrity to prevent premature failure) with regulatory compliance for recycled content (h) and recyclability (d) by avoiding multi-material overmolding or fiber reinforcements that contaminate recycling streams.
decisions.design_action: Investigate the impact strength and tensile properties of various grades of recycled ABS to confirm they meet the structural requirements for vacuum cleaner housings without requiring glass-fiber reinforcement.

options_evaluated: Reversible snap-fits and standardized screws with metal inserts
Co-molded snap-fits that break upon disassembly
decisions.conflict: Manufacture Agent recommends automated ultrasonic welding or simple snap-fits to minimize production complexity and energy, while In-Service Agent rejects permanent joining methods because they prevent non-destructive disassembly for repair.
espr_constraint: ESPR 2024/1781 Annex I (b), page 79: ease of repair and maintenance
ESPR 2024/1781 Annex I (c), page 79: ease of upgrading, reuse, remanufacturing and refurbishment
ESPR 2024/1781 Annex I (g), page 33: use or consumption of energy and resources in production
decisions.chief_resolution: Threaded fasteners (screws) with metal inserts combined with reversible snap-fits. This complies with ESPR Annex I (b) ease of repair and maintenance by enabling non-destructive disassembly using common tools, which overrides manufacturing cost and assembly time considerations under the priority hierarchy.
decisions.design_action: Verify the sealing effectiveness of the proposed mechanical joining method to ensure it maintains airtightness and suction performance without requiring permanent adhesives or gaskets.

options_evaluated: Brushless DC (BLDC) motor with rare-earth magnets
Brushed DC motor with copper windings and lead-solder connections
decisions.conflict: Material and Design Agent recommends a rare-earth-free synchronous reluctance motor to avoid critical raw materials and substances of concern, while In-Service Agent recommends a brushless DC motor to maximize energy efficiency and technical lifetime.
espr_constraint: ESPR 2024/1781 Annex I (a), page 79: durability and reliability of the product or its components
ESPR 2024/1781 Annex I (g), page 79: use or consumption of energy, water and other resources
ESPR 2024/1781 Annex I (f), page 81: use of substances of concern and critical raw materials
decisions.chief_resolution: Brushless DC (BLDC) motor designed with a modular architecture for easy extraction of rare-earth magnets and copper windings. This choice satisfies the high energy efficiency (g) and durability (a) requirements of the in-service phase, while the modular design addresses circularity and recycling (d) by allowing clean separation of critical raw materials at end-of-life.
decisions.design_action: Confirm the disassembly sequence and tool requirements for extracting the rotor magnets and stator windings from the motor housing to ensure high-purity material recovery.

options_evaluated: Active cooling fan integrated on motor shaft with thermal cut-out switch
Passive heat sinking using extruded aluminum
decisions.conflict: In-Service Agent recommends an active cooling fan with a thermal cut-out switch to prevent motor overheating and extend lifetime, while Circularity Agent recommends passive cooling to avoid thermal interface materials and potting compounds that contaminate recycling streams.
espr_constraint: ESPR 2024/1781 Annex I (a), page 79: durability and reliability of the product or its components
ESPR 2024/1781 Annex I (s), page 80: functional performance and conditions for use
ESPR 2024/1781 Annex I (d), page 80: ease and quality of recycling
decisions.chief_resolution: Active cooling fan integrated on motor shaft with thermal cut-out switch, implemented without chemical potting compounds or adhesives. Engineering feasibility and reliability (preventing motor burnout under continuous heavy loads) dictate active cooling, which directly supports durability (a) and functional performance (s). Potting compounds are avoided to ensure recyclability (d).
decisions.design_action: Investigate alternative mechanical fastening methods for mounting the thermal cut-out switch and securing electronics to eliminate the need for chemical thermal pastes or potting compounds.

options_evaluated: Fully modular architecture with toolless swappable functional blocks
Semi-modular design with internal wiring harnesses requiring basic tools
decisions.conflict: Manufacture Agent recommends a monolithic integrated chassis to simplify assembly and reduce manufacturing waste, while Circularity Agent recommends a fully modular architecture with toolless swappable blocks to facilitate repair, upgrading, and remanufacturing.
espr_constraint: ESPR 2024/1781 Annex I (b), page 79: ease of repair and maintenance
ESPR 2024/1781 Annex I (c), page 79: ease of upgrading, reuse, remanufacturing and refurbishment
ESPR 2024/1781 Annex I (e), page 79: avoidance of technical solutions detrimental to reuse, upgrading, repair, maintenance, refurbishment, remanufacturing and recycling
decisions.chief_resolution: Fully modular architecture with toolless swappable functional blocks (motor, battery/power module, filtration, cord reel). ESPR Annex I (b) and (c) mandate design for repairability, remanufacturing, and upgrading. A monolithic design is rejected because it causes premature obsolescence of the entire product when a single component fails, which directly violates regulatory compliance.
decisions.design_action: Check the dimensional and weight impacts of the modular interface connectors to ensure they do not excessively increase the overall product volume and packaging requirements.

options_evaluated: Mains-powered corded (AC) with a modular, retractable cord reel
Removable and replaceable Lithium-ion battery pack with cobalt-free cells
decisions.conflict: In-Service Agent highlights that battery power is required for optimal mobility and functional performance, while Circularity Agent rejects batteries due to end-of-life hazardous waste and safety hazards.
espr_constraint: ESPR 2024/1781 Annex I (a), page 79: durability and reliability of the product or its components
ESPR 2024/1781 Annex I (r), page 80: amounts of waste generated
ESPR 2024/1781 Annex I (s), page 80: functional performance and conditions for use
decisions.chief_resolution: Mains-powered corded (AC) with a modular, retractable cord reel. While cordless battery-powered options offer higher mobility, the regulatory focus on minimizing hazardous waste (r) and environmental footprint (m) under ESPR, combined with the extreme durability and reliability (a) of corded power (avoiding battery degradation), justifies a corded design. To mitigate mobility limitations, a long, high-flexibility cord with a modular, easily repairable retractable reel will be implemented.
decisions.design_action: Investigate the usability requirements and typical cord length preferences for domestic vacuum cleaners to optimize the cord reel design for maximum user reach and convenience.
